# Linux Base64 Decode Piped to a Shell
# id: 95b6875c-5f4d-4aba-911c-27eeca889143
# source: rules/linux/base64_decode_pipe_shell.yml
# format: Elasticsearch Lucene
# Field names are the Sigma field names. No product pipeline was applied.
# Generated by python3 -m rulelab convert. Do not edit by hand.
command_line:*base64* AND (command_line:(*\ \-d* OR *\ \-\-decode*)) AND (command_line:(*\|\ bash* OR *\|\ sh* OR *\|bash* OR *\|sh*))
